state.how_to_read_move_options: Each move option ends with exact facts computed by a chess program: whether it delivers or allows checkmate, the material outcome of the exchange on the destination square (positive = we win material), which of our pieces it leaves hanging, which enemy pieces it newly attacks, and whether it repeats a position. Never choose a move that allows checkmate. Avoid moves that lose material or leave pieces hanging unless they deliver checkmate. Prefer moves that win material, attack undefended pieces, or improve the position. Avoid repeating positions when a good alternative exists.
